title: Grandmasters
text:
Professions now go all the way to level 20: a Grandmaster rank, new materials in the Scorched Reach and on the Stormwake Coast, level 19 and 20 crafted gear, and daily work orders.

✨ Grandmaster rank for every profession: skill goes up to 375. Train it at your profession trainer from level 16
✨ New materials: Emberite Ore and Ashbloom grow only in the Scorched Reach. Sunfire Rubies come from mining Emberite, and Storm Snappers and rare Tide Pearls are caught on the Stormwake Coast
✨ Over 40 Grandmaster recipes: Emberite weapons and plate, Cinderscale leather, Embersilk cloth, Sunfire jewellery and wands (item level 19), and six epic item level 20 recipes at the very top
✨ New consumables: Flask of the Inferno, Elixir of the Phoenix, Superior Healing Draughts, Emberite Whetstones, Cinderscale Armour Kits, Embersilk Spellthread and three new Grandmaster meals
✨ Daily work orders: every trainer has a job for each profession you know. Deliver it for gold, experience and +3 skill. Today's order also shows in your Professions window (K)
🔧 Beasts of the Scorched Reach can now be skinned for Cinderscale, and the humanoids of the Reach and the Coast drop cloth
🔧 Fishing on the Stormwake Coast now catches coast fish instead of only Amber Perch
🔧 Rich nodes now give 2 or 3 materials as promised, and skilled gatherers and skinners sometimes get an extra one
✨ Five new achievements: Artisan, Grandmaster, Master Angler, Reliable Hands and Hands of a Maker
